admission.justification: A retired dataset name reached through an index module would regress the retirement without a failing test.

applicability: The derived-index modules and the helper-caller census.
conditions: The index modules may open their own cache only.
exclusions: The citation package, which reads its own source index.
statement: Derived-index modules cannot touch retired dataset names, helper callers are pinned and only the citation package is exempt from other-store source rules.
